text: Right now I feel pretty good about myself and my family . I am participating in a continuing education program which I enjoy and I have plans for the next two days . I also plan to go the the gym this afternoon . however , I am concerned about the November election .\ n \ n

I am placid and relaxed . However , I am also thinking about the future for my children and grandchildren , which worries me . I have to run several errands this morning and I would rather be doing something else . I also miss the ability to take trips due to my wife’s illness .

I am feeling content and relaxed . Although I worry about the future for my children and grandchildren , I know that I am lucky that they are all doing well . My wife had a stroke four years ago that left her unable to walk without assistance . This has eliminated our travel plans and other plans , but we are dealing with the situation .

I feel content but worried about the future for my children and grandchildren .   I am somewhat frustrated by our inability to travel due to my wife’s disability caused by a stroke 4 years ago . My life is ok but not exciting .
